item.title: From GAN to WGAN
item.description:
[Updated on 2018-09-30: thanks to Yoonju, we have this post translated in Korean !]
[Updated on 2019-04-18: this post is also available on arXiv .] Generative adversarial network (GAN) has shown great results in many generative tasks to replicate the real-world rich content such as images, human language, and music.
